requirements.text: The portal must allow patients to book, cancel, and change their appointments online.
Patients should be able to submit repeat prescription requests through the portal by providing necessary information, such as their name, date of birth, and medication name.
A secure login or verification system must be implemented to protect patient data and ensure only authorized individuals can access their information.
The portal should maintain a straightforward and user-friendly interface to minimize complexity for both patients and staff.
Compliance with regulations regarding patient information privacy and security must be ensured.
